initial_problem: Bootloop after installing official ISP-US 2.1.0 Build 20260829 firmware.
previous_recovery_attempt: The official X55 v1 1.2.2 recovery image uploaded, but the bootloop persisted.
outcome: The owner confirmed successful recovery after using the modified stock 1.6.7 image.
evidence_type: Owner confirmation in the follow-up conversation; not a direct device measurement by the host test harness.
scope: Reported EU X50 v1.0 case only. Other hardware revisions and bootloaders are not validated by this report.
